answer_1.quote: We present GuessingGame, a protocol for evaluating large language models as question-askers in open-ended, open-domain settings.
answer_1.outputs: free-form questions in a multi-turn dialogue setting

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using two primary metrics. First, Success Rate (SR)... Second, Average Number of Questions (ANQ)... We introduce two complementary measures of information gain (IG)...

answer_3.quote: We introduce an Interpreter model—an LLM which is prompted to take the latest question and answer as input and returns a scored list of concepts...

answer_4.quote: we conducted a small-scale evaluation with human participants. Two of the paper's authors (familiar with the task design) and two unpaid naive volunteers (with no prior exposure) each completed 40 games...
answer_4.guideline: Participants played the GuessingGame under the standard 50-turn limit, asking questions to identify a hidden object.
